title: For each customer, calculate their daily balances for every day between the
question: For each customer, calculate their daily balances for every day between their earliest and latest transaction dates, including days without transactions by carrying forward the previous day's balance. Treat any negative daily balances as zero. Then, for each month, determine the highest daily balance each customer had during that month. Finally, for each month, sum these maximum daily balances across all customers to obtain a monthly total.

prediction.sql:
WITH RECURSIVE
bounds AS (
  SELECT customer_id, MIN(txn_date) AS min_d, MAX(txn_date) AS max_d
  FROM customer_transactions
  GROUP BY customer_id
),
cal AS (
  SELECT customer_id, min_d AS d, max_d FROM bounds
  UNION ALL
  SELECT customer_id, DATE(d, '+1 day'), max_d FROM cal WHERE d < max_d
),
daily AS (
  SELECT c.customer_id, c.d,
         MAX(CASE WHEN t.txn_type='deposit' THEN t.txn_amount ELSE 0 END)
       - MAX(CASE WHEN t.txn_type='withdrawal' THEN t.txn_amount ELSE 0 END)
       - MAX(CASE WHEN t.txn_type='purchase' THEN t.txn_amount ELSE 0 END) AS bal
  FROM cal c
  LEFT JOIN customer_transactions t
    ON t.customer_id=c.customer_id AND t.txn_date=c.d
  GROUP BY c.customer_id, c.d
),
clamped AS (
  SELECT customer_id, d, MAX(0, bal) AS bal FROM daily
)
SELECT strftime('%Y-%m', d) AS month, SUM(bal) AS monthly_total
FROM clamped
GROUP BY strftime('%Y-%m', d)
ORDER BY month;

WITH bounds AS (
  SELECT customer_id, MIN(txn_date) AS min_d, MAX(txn_date) AS max_d
  FROM customer_transactions GROUP BY customer_id
),
days AS (
  SELECT b.customer_id,
         DATE(b.min_d, '+' || (d.n || ' days')) AS day
  FROM bounds b
  JOIN (
    SELECT 0 n UNION ALL SELECT 1 UNION ALL SELECT 2 UNION ALL SELECT 3 UNION ALL SELECT 4

    UNION ALL SELECT 85 UNION ALL SELECT 86 UNION ALL SELECT 87 UNION ALL SELECT 88 UNION ALL SELECT 89
    UNION ALL SELECT 90 UNION ALL SELECT 91 UNION ALL SELECT 92 UNION ALL SELECT 93 UNION ALL SELECT 94
    UNION ALL SELECT 95 UNION ALL SELECT 96 UNION ALL SELECT 97 UNION ALL SELECT 98 UNION ALL SELECT 99
  ) d ON d.n <= CAST(julianday(b.max_d) - julianday(b.min_d) AS INTEGER)
),
txn AS (
  SELECT customer_id, txn_date,
         SUM(CASE WHEN txn_type='deposit' THEN txn_amount
                  WHEN txn_type='withdrawal' THEN -txn_amount
                  ELSE 0 END) AS net
  FROM customer_transactions GROUP BY customer_id, txn_date
),
daily AS (
  SELECT d.customer_id, d.day,
         MAX(CASE WHEN t.txn_date IS NOT NULL
                  THEN (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(t2.net),0) FROM txn t2
                        WHERE t2.customer_id=d.customer_id AND t2.txn_date<=d.day)
                  ELSE NULL END) AS bal
  FROM days d
  LEFT JOIN txn t ON t.customer_id=d.customer_id AND t.txn_date=d.day
  GROUP BY d.customer_id, d.day
),
filled AS (
  SELECT customer_id, day,
         MAX(bal) OVER (PARTITION BY customer_id ORDER BY day
                        ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS bal
  FROM daily
),
monthly AS (
  SELECT strftime('%Y-%m', day) AS month, customer_id,
         MAX(MAX(CASE WHEN bal<0 THEN 0 ELSE bal END)) AS max_bal
  FROM filled
  GROUP BY strftime('%Y-%m', day), customer_id
)
SELECT month, SUM(max_bal) AS monthly_total
FROM monthly
GROUP BY month
ORDER BY month;
